details:
NODISTURP | ORBITAL INTELLIGENCE

Project Details

NODISTURP | ORBITAL INTELLIGENCE is an interactive Earth and Space Intelligence platform created to address NASA’s challenge, “Be An Earth System Trend Detective!” Our goal is to make complex scientific information easier to explore, understand and use.

What does our project do?

Our platform allows users to explore Earth science information and investigate environmental changes over time. Users can select variables such as temperature, rainfall, sea level, vegetation and other environmental measurements. They can explore different geographical regions, compare historical data and visualize changes through interactive maps, charts and a 3D Earth experience.

The platform is designed to help answer five important questions: What is changing? Where is it changing? How much is it changing? Over what period is it changing? And is the change statistically significant?

We also aim to make scientific information easier to understand through an AI Earth Scientist, alongside additional space exploration features such as satellite tracking, rocket launches and space missions.

Benefits and intended impact

We want to make Earth science more accessible to students, researchers and the public. Environmental data can be difficult to understand, especially when measurements come from different locations and time periods. By bringing information together in one platform, NODISTURP aims to help users recognize patterns, investigate environmental trends and develop a better understanding of our changing planet.

Development and technology

Our team spent months learning, researching, coding, testing and improving the project. We dedicated significant time to understanding the challenge, exploring scientific information, planning features, designing the interface and working towards making the platform functional.

We used modern web development technologies and programming tools to develop the interactive interface, data visualizations, scientific features and 3D experience. Netlify is used to host and publish our website. It provides an accessible and reliable platform with a free hosting option, allowing us to deploy updates and make our project available online.

Creativity and innovation

What makes NODISTURP different is our attempt to combine Earth science, space exploration, interactive 3D visualization and AI into one connected experience. Instead of simply displaying information, our goal is to help users investigate real environmental changes and understand what the results mean.

Factors considered

During development, we considered scientific accuracy, reliable information sources, accessibility, ease of use, performance and compatibility with different devices. We also considered the importance of clearly showing data sources, limitations and uncertainty so users can understand how scientific conclusions are reached.

NODISTURP represents months of learning, teamwork, creativity and dedication. Our ambition is to turn complex Earth science information into an experience that anyone can explore and understand.
